messages:
alex: Hi team — New POC with Meridian (financial analytics). They want a hosted API key + temporary QPS bump for a 2-hr demo on 2026-04-28. Can we provision an ephemeral key with IP allowlist and a burst window?

maria: Quick q's — what peak QPS do they expect? avg tokens/request? streaming or sync calls? region requirements?

alex: Meridian estimates ~150 concurrent users. Average ~50 tokens/request. They want ~200 qps sustained, 500 qps burst for ~15m. Some calls use streaming. EU region preferred (eu-west).

sam: Thanks. Clarify: 200 qps sustained vs 500 burst — is burst needed at start of demo only? We can do scoped ephemeral key pinned to eu-west. Default hosted scoped keys cap at 100 qps; >200 needs infra sign-off.

maria: Burst is mainly for the first 10–15 minutes when attendees flood the demo. After that it's ~180–200 qps. IP allowlist required, short TTL (3h).

sam: Proposed plan: create ephemeral scoped key TTL=3h, region=eu-west, sustained_qps=200, burst=500 for 15m, window 14:00–16:00 UTC on 2026-04-28. Add IP allowlist and streaming timeout bump. Need cost sign-off from @jordan for infra reserve. Also will set an automatic fallback to a smaller model if we hit sustained limits.

jordan: Provisionally approve for demo. Need a ballpark cost figure to confirm. Also confirm logs are redacted and data doesn't leave region.

ops-bot: INF ticket created: INF-4472 — temporary capacity reservation request (200 qps sustained / 500 burst).

sam: Opening infra ticket and tagging Eng-SRE. I'll also add health-check endpoints and a small canary ramp 30m prior. Example smoke test: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral_key>" \ 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

nina: INF-4472 acknowledged. We can allocate an ephemeral pool for the 2-hr window. We need contact info for POC lead + on-call contact during the demo. We'll handle cleanup after.

alex: POC lead: lily@meridian.com. On-call: sam (platform). Schedule: 2026-04-28T14:00Z–16:00Z. Cost estimate?

sam: Rough reserve cost for the additional capacity and burst buffer: ~$480 for the 2-hour window. This includes burst headroom and monitoring.

deploy-bot: Ephemeral key created: rk_demo_ephem_2098765432 (TTL 3h). QPS policy => sustained:200, burst:500 (15m). IP allowlist: 52.31.12.0/24. Region pin: eu-west. Console: https://console.redwood.ai/keys/rk_demo_ephem_2098765432

lily: Got the key, thanks. One small ask: can we increase streaming chunk timeout to 90s for the demo? Some of our streams go long.

sam: Yep — bumped streaming timeout to 120s for that key. Also added prompt/token caps to protect against runaway requests.

lily: Verified streaming in staging. We'll run a full smoke 30m before start. :party_parrot:

alex: Excellent. After the demo we'll rotate/revoke the key and revert limits. @nina please confirm cleanup cadence.

nina: Cleanup scheduled: revoke key + deallocate pool at 2026-04-28T18:00Z. Logs retained 30d, PII redaction enabled. :white_check_mark:
